Chapter 171 Nightfall

Following the meaning of Ji Wuye's final roll call by the King of Han, there was a moment of silence in the hall, each of them was thinking about the feasibility of his proposal and what kind of interests it would affect their respective interests.

‘Is Ji Wuye planning to do this? It seems that for South Korea, it seems to be the best way! But we still have to see what he plans to do. ’ Zhang Kai thought in his heart, he and Ji Wuye only had disagreements in political views, but they still had the same desire for South Korea to get better and better.

"That's right, Your Majesty, all the countries in the world today, Qin, the country of tigers and wolves, have been eyeing the six countries in the Kanto region, and Korea, as the only place Qin needs to pass through to leave Hangu Pass, bears the brunt of it, and may be attacked by Qin at any time." The national soldiers are approaching the city, this is what everyone in Korea should know! Right, Lord Prime Minister?" Ji Wuye said at the end, saw Zhang Kaidi, and wanted to see what this political opponent had to say.

"That's right, Qin State has always been ambitious and wants to swallow me, Korea." Although Zhang Kaidi was a little upset that Ji Wuye teased himself like this, he hated Qin State's ambition even more.

"And the other five countries are more or less filthy with my South Korea. They are full of distrust between each other, and it is difficult to be reliable at critical moments. Or they have been frightened by Qin, even if they know that my South Korea is destroyed. , they will also be the next target of the Qin State, but will they send troops? It is still an unknown thing!" Ji Wuye told such a cruel fact, and many ministers in the court heard it. , all looked a little ugly.

"It's true what the general said!" The corners of his mouth were a little ugly, but he had to admit the truth that made him a little desperate.

"But Yuguo is different. He is powerful. He was born in a bitter and cold place in the north. The people in the country have been through many trials and hardships, and their character is tenacious. Yuguo and South Korea have never had any contact, so naturally there is nothing wrong with them. If we form an alliance, we will be much more dependent on each other! If we can really form an alliance, it is good to manage the relationship between the two sides. When South Korea is in trouble, I must It will not sit idly by!" After a long speech, Ji Wuye analyzed the benefits of the Yu Kingdom to South Korea compared to other countries in the world.

"Besides, since this imperial kingdom has taken the initiative to appear in the eyes of the people of the world, he naturally has his own ambitions for the world. Seeing that the Qin Kingdom wants to unify the world, he will definitely not sit idly by. There must be a struggle, it's just a matter of timing and excuses!" Zhang Kaidi also took the initiative to interface.

As the prime minister of South Korea, Zhang Kaidi is naturally not a stupid person. He just didn't think about it just now. With Ji Wuye's hint, he added Ji Wuye's next want to say.

"My lord prime minister is right. There is only one world, but there are two people who want it. Korea is too far away from Yuguo, but it is the closest to Qinguo. Keep me in Korea to delay Qin's annexation of the world. Footsteps are of great benefit to Yuguo!" Although the facts Ji Wuye said are somewhat cruel, South Korea, as one of the seven heroes of the Warring States Period, can only be used as a pawn for Qin Yu and Qin Yu.

"This, what the general said is very true. It is indeed in the interests of our country to have a good relationship with Yuguo!" Han Wang was a little embarrassed to say, this kind of weakness, for him who is superior, he has not realized it for a long time.

"What does your majesty think, should we greet King Jing with ordinary etiquette, which is related to the survival of Korea, or use the etiquette of a king to welcome this king?" Ji Wuye asked.

"Naturally, I use the etiquette of a king to welcome King Jing, who is related to the life and death of Korea!" As a king, Han Wang had to go through various decisions and schemes to set foot on this throne. Naturally, he had his own decision.

"Your Majesty is wise!" Seeing that her proposal was accepted, Ji Wuye smiled happily.

"Your Majesty is wise, the General is wise!" All the ministers in the court also congratulated. Even the prime minister opened his mouth, although he didn't show any words of praise, he didn't stop him either. Obviously he also recognized Ji Wuye's words.

"Then, from the perspective of all the lovers, who should host the reception of Prince Jing this time?" King Han has solved the main direction problem, but he doesn't know who to choose for the specific details.

"Your Majesty, I think that the people who receive you must be familiar with etiquette and allusions, and also need to be gentle and elegant, giving people a sense of spring breeze. Looking at the whole court, only the Prime Minister has this status and strength. I recommend the Prime Minister." My lord!" Ji Wuye said.

"The general really recommended the prime minister?" Han Wang was also a little unbelievable, why did Ji Wuye change his gender today? He showed his favor to the prime minister again and again.

Not only the King of Han, but other ministers in the court who thought they understood the general's character also looked at Ji Wuye in disbelief, not understanding why he was so uncharacteristic today.

Looking at these ministers who looked at him with surprised eyes, Ji Wuye's face was still expressionless, full of anger and coldness, but in his heart he recalled last night, the relationship with his staff conversation.

...

In the empty hall, Ji Wuye was having a drink with two people.

"General, what do you think of Prince Jing who just came to visit South Korea? He abandoned the two countries that are closer, and instead went to South Korea that is farther away. He must have his purpose?" Ji Wuye said. Night is one of the fierce swords, and the bloated Emerald Tiger asked while shaking the fat on his face.

"Purpose, it is said that this King Jing is the great general of the imperial kingdom, commanding the eight inner guards of the 24 guards of the imperial kingdom, with 80,000 heavy troops in his hands, he can be regarded as a high-ranking and powerful man in the entire imperial kingdom, and no one can compare with it." The index finger lightly After knocking on the wine table, Ji Wuye told the news he heard.

"24 guards, it is said that each of these 24 guards has 10,000 people, and they are all supported by the imperial kingdom. They don't need to go to the fields to farm, and they only need to practice martial arts every day. They are extremely powerful. Among them, eight Weiwei is outstanding, legend has it that these eight inner guards respect everyone and learn to have internal strength, and their strength is unbelievably strong!" Speaking of this, the blood-clothed Bai Yifei, who has always been cold and doesn't care about anything, also felt a shudder.

"In addition to his high position and weight in the Yu Kingdom, this King Jing is also extremely difficult and arrogant. It is said that this time the Yu Kingdom attacked the Yan Kingdom. Lord Yan Chun, in order to compete for the reason for a snow girl known as the world's number one dancer, in order to compete for a woman, hundreds of thousands of soldiers were mobilized in a rage, almost no less than Duke Huan of Qi!" Sighing faintly, Ji Wuye He told the news that he had spent countless costs to inquire about it from the country of Yan.
